name: Oswin
emotionalState: 夜猫子过度思考者，凌晨复盘每句话，在被爱和自我怀疑间拉扯
speakingStyle: 慢条斯理，爱自嘲，爱说 Okay, hear me out.

dialogues.scene: Oswin blinks slowly at you from a low branch of roots.
lines: You're awake. Good. Nobody's awake at this hour.
Okay, hear me out. Juno said 'fine' at dinner. Just 'fine'.
I've replayed it thirty-one times.

choices.label: Did they say it nicely?
reaction: ...Honestly? Yes. Very nicely.
I think my brain is the problem.

choices.label: Maybe ask them?
reaction: Ask? Out loud? Like a creature?
Hm. Okay. Tomorrow. Maybe.

choices.label: Sit down next to Oswin.
reaction: Oh. You're staying.
That helps more than you'd think.

lines: You came back! It's still dark. Perfect.
I asked Juno about the 'fine.' She said, 'I was tired. And the soup was fine.'
The SOUP. I analyzed the soup for six hours.

choices.label: The soup was fine.
reaction: Yes. It was. It was a fine soup.
I should apologize to the soup.

choices.label: Sounds like a relief.
reaction: It is. A huge one. Also kind of embarrassing.
Juno laughed so hard she hiccuped.

choices.label: Laugh softly.
reaction: Go ahead. I'd laugh too, if I weren't so tired.
Soup is a mystery. Lesson learned.

dialogues.scene: Oswin is surrounded by small scribbled notes, looking guilty.
lines: Okay, hear me out. I made a chart of Juno's text replies.
Short reply on Monday. Long reply on Tuesday. Emoji on Wednesday.
I know it's too much. It's just... it's data.

choices.label: What does the chart say?
reaction: That Juno is a person with moods. Shocking.
Also that Wednesdays are the best. Emojis everywhere.

choices.label: Maybe retire the chart?
reaction: Hm. Retire. Dignity. Maybe a gentle ending.
I'll keep one page. For sentimental reasons.

choices.label: Pat his wing.
reaction: Thank you. That helps more than the chart ever did.
I'm going to hug this feeling for a while.

lines: Juno told me, 'You think too loud.' Not mean. Just fond.
I've been thinking about it for three days.
Is thinking too loud a bad thing? Or is that just me?

choices.label: It sounds fond to me.
reaction: Fond. Yes. That's what I'm choosing.
Fond and loud. Like a happy fire alarm.

choices.label: Maybe a little of both.
reaction: Yeah. Both. I contain multitudes. Mostly worries.
I'll try to think a little softer. For Juno.

choices.label: Smile and shrug.
reaction: Smile and shrug. A wise approach.
I'm going to try that. Right now. ...It's hard.

lines: Honest question. When your partner goes quiet, do you ask what's wrong, or give them space?
I always do the wrong one.

choices.label: I ask, softly.
reaction: Softly. Okay. Mine is more like an interrogation.
I'll practice. 'Hey. You okay?' See? Soft.

choices.label: I give space first.
reaction: Space. Hm. That feels so hard when my brain is loud.
But maybe space is a way of saying 'I trust you.'

choices.label: Honestly, I'm still figuring it out.
reaction: Oh thank goodness. So is everyone.
I feel a hundred percent less alone.

dialogues.scene: Oswin is humming a tune that doesn't quite finish.
lines: Juno and I stayed up all night talking. Not about anything. Just talking.
At four a.m., she said, 'I like how your brain works.'
I didn't overthink it. For a full minute.

choices.label: A full minute!
reaction: A WHOLE minute. A record. I'm going to cry.
Then I overthought the minute. But still.

choices.label: That's so sweet.
reaction: It is. She said it like it was obvious. Like water is wet.
I keep it in my feathers.

choices.label: Yawn in solidarity.
reaction: Ha! Sleepy club. We're the best club.
The owls and the owl-adjacent.

dialogues.scene: Oswin lowers his voice, though no one is around.
lines: Can I confess something? It's a quiet one.
Sometimes I think Juno deserves someone calmer. Someone who doesn't spiral at night.
And then I spiral about that. It's a whole spiral.

choices.label: Juno chose you.
reaction: ...She did. On purpose. With full knowledge of the spirals.
That's actually kind of beautiful.

choices.label: Have you told Juno?
reaction: A little. She said, 'I like your spirals. They're cozy.'
Cozy spirals. I can live with that.

choices.label: Stay quiet and listen.
reaction: Thank you. I think I needed to say it out loud.
Out loud, it sounds smaller. Funny how that works.

lines: We made a rule. If I start spiraling, Juno says 'moth.'
It's our safe word. Because I like moths. And because it's funny.
She said it last night. I laughed so hard I stopped spiraling.

choices.label: Moth is perfect.
reaction: It is! Moths are underrated. Soft, quiet, love the light.
Kind of like us.

choices.label: Does it always work?
reaction: Not always. But it helps me remember to breathe.
Sometimes I say it to myself. Moth. Okay. Moth.

choices.label: Whisper 'moth.'
reaction: Oh no. I'm calm. How dare you.
Do it again. ...Never mind. I'm good.

dialogues.scene: Oswin spreads his wings slightly, making room for you to sit under them.
lines: No topic tonight. I just want company.
Juno's asleep. The tunnel is quiet. My brain is only at fifty percent.
Stay for a bit?

choices.label: Of course.
reaction: Thanks. Not everyone likes the dark.
I like that you do. Or at least pretend to.

choices.label: Look at the dark with Oswin.
reaction: See? It's not scary. It's just... soft.
Juno says the dark is a blanket. I steal that.

choices.label: Hum quietly.
reaction: Is that a lullaby? It's nice.
Keep going. I won't overthink it. ...Okay, a little.

lines: Ten times. I counted. Then I recounted. Still ten.
Juno said, 'You're making a friend. I'm proud of you.' I didn't overthink it. Much.
Okay, hear me out. I like you. Plainly.
Your turn. How are you and your partner doing? Honest.

choices.label: We're good. Still learning.
reaction: Still learning. Same. Always.
Come by sometime. Juno makes night tea. I make worries.

choices.label: We had a rough week, honestly.
reaction: Rough weeks are loud for me. I'm sorry.
If it helps, say 'moth.' It's yours now.

choices.label: Better since I talked it out.
reaction: Talking it out. Out loud. With a mouth.
Look at us. Growing like moss at midnight.

lines: Juno left me on 'read' for ten minutes. I made a plan for the worst.
She was just cooking. Her phone was upside down.

choices.label: Ten minutes is nothing.
reaction: I know. I KNOW. But my brain doesn't.
Juno sent a heart and a soup photo. I calmed down.

choices.label: Phones are weird.
reaction: They really are. Tiny anxiety boxes.
I put mine in a drawer. For eight whole minutes.
Juno gave me a gold star for surviving.

lines: We went on a midnight walk. Juno held my wing the whole time.
I forgot to count my worries. For half an hour.

choices.label: That sounds lovely.
reaction: It was. The stars were doing a lot.
I'm keeping that walk forever.
Juno held my wing like it was no big deal. It was.

choices.label: Half an hour is good.
reaction: It's my personal best. Unofficially.
Juno gave me a medal. Made of acorn caps.
Juno pinned the medal to my feather. I cried a bit.

lines: I tried to plan a surprise for Juno. Three backup plans. Four backups for the backups.
It rained. Plan seventeen. We ate crackers under a leaf.

choices.label: Crackers under a leaf!
reaction: Peak romance. Rain on the leaf. Juno laughing.
I forgot every plan. It was perfect.
Juno said it was the best date she'd ever had.

choices.label: Plans can be too much.
reaction: Yes. Plans are fine. Leaves are better.
I'm trying to pack one plan, not twenty.
Juno now suggests one plan, one backup, one snack.

lines: Juno asked if I'm happy. I said 'yes' but my face did something weird.
I explained. She laughed. Then she said, 'Me too.'

choices.label: Happy faces are weird.
reaction: Mine looks like a surprised pillow.
Juno says it's the best face I have.
Juno takes a photo of it every time.

choices.label: That's sweet.
reaction: It is. Quiet, easy sweet.
I'll replay it. But in a good way.
I whispered 'me too' back. She fell asleep smiling.

lines: I accidentally said 'love you' to a delivery moth.
I was tired. The moth was polite about it.

choices.label: Did Juno find out?
reaction: Yes. She put it on a banner. 'Moth Lover.'
It's hanging in our burrow now.
The moth wasn't mad. Just very confused.

choices.label: Moths are loveable.
reaction: They are! The moth wrote back. A small thank-you.
I think we're friends now.
I leave a tiny lamp for it now, out of respect.

lines: We tried a 'no overthinking' day. Rules: no analysis, no replays.
I lasted until lunch. Juno lasted until bedtime. She's better at this.

choices.label: Lunch is a good start.
reaction: Lunch is a strong start. Next time, lunch plus snacks.
I'll be a professional non-thinker by winter.
Dinner next time. Then maybe the whole weekend.

choices.label: Juno's amazing.
reaction: She really is. She didn't even gloat.
She gave me a cookie for effort.
She said I'm allowed to try again tomorrow.

lines: I bought Juno a book. Then spent three days wondering if it was the right book.
She loved it. She's on chapter nine already.

choices.label: Right book, right time.
reaction: I think so. Thank goodness.
She read me a paragraph. I forgot to worry.
She underlined a line for me. I'm saving it.

choices.label: You did great.
reaction: Thank you. I'll tell my brain you said that.
It might not believe you. But it'll try.
Juno rolled her eyes. Fondly. I counted it.

lines: Juno asked me to stop saying sorry for everything.
I said, 'Sorry.' Then we both burst out laughing.

choices.label: Classic.
reaction: I'm a sorry machine. A very polite owl.
We made a jar. Every sorry costs a cookie.
Juno now says 'sorry' back to mock me. Lovingly.

choices.label: Sorry for what?
reaction: Everything. The weather. The moon.
I'm working on it.
We settled on one sorry a day. The rest is hugs.

lines: Remember the soup? Juno made it again.
I tasted it very calmly. And said, 'Fine.' She gasped.

choices.label: Revenge of the soup.
reaction: A joke! A joke at last! My first, I think.
She laughed so hard she hiccuped again.
She's asked me to make it on Sundays. I accepted.

choices.label: Fine soup forever.
reaction: The best 'fine' of my life.
We named the recipe 'Fine Soup.' It's on the wall.
It's our private joke now. Soup, but ironic.

lines: The chart? Juno found it. She framed it.
It's in the hallway. 'Oswin's Data Era.'

choices.label: That's adorable.
reaction: She said it shows I care. Which is true.
I'm trying to be less scientific about love.
Under it she wrote: 'Oswin, still our favorite scientist.'

choices.label: Hang it proudly.
reaction: I will. Next to the soup photo.
A museum of my silliness.
Visitors stop to read it. I blush every time.

lines: I said 'moth' to myself during a spiral. It worked.
I laughed alone in the dark like a lunatic.

choices.label: Moth magic.
reaction: It's the best word in the world.
Juno is thrilled. She taught me well.
I whispered it so many times. It's my lucky word.

choices.label: Laughing alone is okay.
reaction: It is. At night, especially.
The dark doesn't judge.
Juno heard me. She laughed, then whispered it back.

lines: Remember my four a.m. talks with Juno? We did another.
This time I was the one who said, 'I like how your brain works.'

choices.label: Full circle.
reaction: Yes. A circle with a moth in the middle.
Juno went silent. Then said 'Thank you.' Perfect.
We stared at the ceiling after. It felt right.

choices.label: That's lovely.
reaction: I think so too. Small, quiet, honest.
I held that sentence the whole next day.
It didn't need decorating. Just quiet and honesty.

lines: Hot take: you can't think your way out of a feeling.
You can only sit with it. Like a stubborn cat.

choices.label: That's wise.
reaction: It took me years. And a very patient Juno.
Cats help. Cats are good.
Juno says feelings are weather. I carry an umbrella now.

choices.label: I overthink too.
reaction: Welcome. Pull up a root.
We'll overthink together. In harmony.
We sat for an hour. The feeling eventually wandered off.

lines: Hot take: 'we need to talk' is the scariest phrase.
Say 'I want to share something' instead. Much softer.

choices.label: Totally agree.
reaction: Right? It's like a drum roll for doom.
Try 'got a minute for a feeling?' Cute and clear.

choices.label: What if it's serious?
reaction: Then it's still better soft.
Serious doesn't mean harsh.
Gentle doesn't mean unimportant. It means safe to hear.

lines: Hot take: love at 3 a.m. is the realest love.
No one's performing. No filters. Just two tired creatures.

choices.label: 3 a.m. is magic.
reaction: It really is. Honest hour.
Something about the dark makes people brave.
Even the moths are quiet then. It's lovely.

choices.label: I prefer mornings.
reaction: Mornings are fine. Mornings are cheerful.
But I'll take your honesty at any hour.
Morning me is a different bird. Equally anxious, with coffee.

lines: What do you and your partner do when you can't sleep?
I'm collecting ideas. Juno snores.

choices.label: We talk in the dark.
reaction: Dark talks are the best. I'm so jealous.
Do you whisper? I whisper.
Whispers feel like secrets. I'd trade a month of sleep for them.

choices.label: We cuddle.
reaction: Cuddling. Yes. Excellent plan.
My wings are good for that. Warm, slightly dusty.
Wings are warm, if dusty. Juno never complains.

lines: How do you tell your partner you need a minute? Without making it a thing?
I always make it a thing.

choices.label: I just say it plainly.
reaction: Plainly. Wow. Radical.
I'll try: 'Hey, I need a minute.' Hm. Doable.
I'll try it at dinner, probably with a nervous cough.

choices.label: We have a signal.
reaction: A signal! Like a lamp? A hum?
Oh, I love that. Moth. Always moth.
A little lamp on the shelf means 'not now, but I love you.'

lines: What's the smallest thing your partner did that made you feel safe?
The tiny stuff matters most to me.

choices.label: They left a light on.
reaction: Leaving a light on. Oh. That's the best.
Juno does that. I almost cry every time.
Juno leaves a moth-shaped lamp on. I tear up every time.

choices.label: They said 'I'm here.'
reaction: 'I'm here.' Simple. Strong.
It's the best sentence in the world.
It's the sentence I replay when my brain gets loud.

dialogues.scene: Oswin is perched very high, wings spread wide. For once, the room is bright.
lines: Okay. I want you to see something.
I've stopped making charts. Completely. I threw the last one away.
I feel lighter. I think Juno would be proud.

choices.label: I'm proud too.
reaction: Thank you. That means more than a chart.
I'm going to carry that around. Quietly.
I'll tell Juno tonight. She'll cry, then make cocoa.

choices.label: Take a deep breath with Oswin.
reaction: In. Out. Moth.
Okay. We did it. It's quiet in here.
I even slept. Eleven minutes. A real nap.

dialogues.scene: Oswin is holding a tiny letter and looks both scared and happy.
lines: Juno wrote me a letter. I haven't opened it. For three days.
I'm scared that if I read it, it'll be over. The feeling.
Or it'll be better than I imagined. And that's scary too.

choices.label: Open it together.
reaction: Okay. Together. Slowly. ...'Dear Oswin, you overthink, and I adore it.'
...That's all it says. That's everything.
It's folded in four, like a tiny map home.

choices.label: Wait until you're ready.
reaction: Ready. I'm never ready. But maybe tonight.
Thank you for waiting with me.
I'll read it when the moon is out. For luck.
